The graph opens upward when $a > 0$ and downward when $a < 0$.
solution_steps_latex: Match $f(x) = 2\left|x - 3\right| + 5$ against the template $f(x) = a|x - h| + k$.
Read off $h = 3$ and $k = 5$, so the vertex is $(3, 5)$.
Since $a = 2$ is positive, the graph opens upward.
